messages:
Maya: Hearing a mystery ringtone in the hallway. 3 people swore it was a whale call. Who brought a nav alarm to the office? :whale: 
Evan: Not me. But I did bring a playlist called 'quiet bops' that might contain a 10s sonar sample.
Rina: lol that's Evan's stealth deploy alarm. He uses it so people know he's about to push.
Evan: Guilty. Wanted something dramatic but polite. Also: who keeps draping umbrellas over the pantry counter like it's an art installation?
Maya: That was me, trying to dry one. Sorry. I will not make it a sculpture anymore.
Sam: Quick poll from @Deploy-bot: preferred deploy ringtone for dramatic-but-not-scary alerts?
Deploy-bot: POLL: Pick a deploy sound (vote by replying with the number)
Deploy-bot: 1) Soft chime 2) Ship horn (short) 3) Subtle marimba 4) Whale song (Evan special)
Maya: 1
Evan: 4 (obviously)
Rina: 3
Sam: 2 for theatrical effect :grin:
Maya: Tally: 1 x1, 2 x1, 3 x1, 4 x1 — tie chaos.
Evan: Tie-breaker haiku challenge. Winner picks ringtone. 3 lines, office-friendly. Ready?
Rina: I start: 'Coffee breath of code / pushes ripple through the slack stream / servers dream in logs'
Maya: 'Desk plant nods, awake / drizzle on keys, deploy hums / quiet victory.'
Sam: 'Lint in my hoodie / staged click, production listens / ship sails, we applaud'
Evan: And the winner is... the one that used the word 'lint' (perfect). Sam gets whale song as a consolation prize. :tada:
Rina: Also kudos to Maya for rescuing the umbrella without making it modern art again. :umbrella:
Maya: Accepting praise and promising to dry umbrellas in the bathroom next time.
Deploy-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x5, :tada: x2
Sam: I'll update the deploy sound to `whale_short.mp3` in the shared drive. Do we want a 2s or 5s clip?
Evan: 2s for mystery, 5s for drama. I'm voting drama.
Rina: 2s — subtle is kind to the coworkers.
Maya: 2s from me too. Peace for sensitive ears.
Sam: Done. whale_short_2s.mp3 uploaded. Case closed, umbrellas pending art decommission. :)
